item: a mail server's error reply ends a mailbox pull in fixed words, never its bytes
summary: imaplib and poplib put the server's line in their exceptions, and on a plain port the greeting and CAPABILITY reply come before STARTTLS, so anyone on the path wrote it; through ingest-email it reached the catch-all 500 uncut (a 350 KB detail from a 350 KB greeting). A greeting or capability failure (an undecodable list included), a PREAUTH greeting on the TLS port, a refused login and a failed later command now end the pull as MailboxServerError in fixed words naming the server, the port and the step; the route answers 502; a Stop still wins, one landing during the LOGOUT included; a local encode failure is not blamed on the server. Every such refusal, and R651's STARTTLS refusals, is raised outside the except that decided it, since http_detail reads the __context__ chain and showed the chained error instead. The catch-all 500 cuts its detail at 300 characters after the scrub on every route, and a serving-gate check that raises gives the fixed 503 with no exception text. Release line: a mail server's own error message no longer appears in the app's errors: a newsletter mailbox pull the server ends says which server, which port and at what step, in the app's own words, and the app's error messages are kept short.
